convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorJJRSX indicator (custom indicator, not built-in), relies on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution and money management, and uses custom CIsNewBar class from external header

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

long.left: ColorJJRSX buffer[1] < buffer[2] AND buffer[0] > buffer[1]

short.left: ColorJJRSX buffer[1] > buffer[2] AND buffer[0] < buffer[1]

other_exits: Signal-based close: SELL_Close triggered when ColorJJRSX buffer[1]<buffer[2] (rising histogram), BUY_Close triggered when buffer[1]>buffer[2] (falling histogram)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects between FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, and LOT (fixed lot). Default is LOT mode. MM=0.1 is the share/fraction parameter interpreted based on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads 3 values from ColorJJRSX buffer at offset SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). The histogram direction change is the core signal: buffer[1]<buffer[2] indicates rising JJRSX (bullish), and if buffer[0]>buffer[1] it confirms continuation, triggering BUY_Open. Vice versa for sell. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick instead of only on new bars. The Recount flag forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates that can individually disable long/short entry and exit.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ColorJJRSX indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a Jurik RSX smoothed by JMA (Jurik Moving Average). The JurX smoothing algorithm and JMA (Jurik Moving Average with phase parameter) are proprietary and non-trivial to replicate exactly. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions - these must be reimplemented with equivalent position management, lot sizing based on MMMode enum, and order execution logic. The CIsNewBar class must be replaced with a new-bar detection mechanism. Signal bar indexing (SignalBar=1 means using previous completed bar) must be handled carefully in Python backtesting to avoid look-ahead bias. The Value[0], Value[1], Value[2] arrays correspond to bars at SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2 offsets respectively.
